acceptanceCriteria: per-test durations for internal/dogfoodflow retained on a quiet host and at load ~60
the package finishes inside its budget at load ~60, or the slowest tests are split/parallelized with the measurement retained; no assertion weakened
body: Observed by the V1-1023/1024 lane (PR #962, 2026-10-16) on darwin at load ~68: `go test -timeout 30m ./internal/dogfoodflow` hit the package alarm while inside TestCheckDCWV0047DeclaredOutputChange (33 s into that test), so the cumulative package runtime is the problem, not one hung test. The guard lane (#961) also could not finish the whole package inside its window. Same load class as V1-1446 (tools/corvint-pr-tests). Suspected, not confirmed on a quiet host.
title: tests (suspected): internal/dogfoodflow package exceeds the 30m package timeout under load ~68
